blocking_counterexamples.implication: The purported bounded rc and stream-size schema permits unbounded/impossible values and contradictory stage evidence.

An independent postrun validator cannot reject a claimed positive route without any preceding local evidence; enum membership alone does not enforce stage order or keep UNKNOWN from becoming a false PROVEN claim.

bounded_positive_findings: The runner pins v2 terminal/peer/root NO_GO and a fresh v3 peer/release/START/TERMINAL chain; v2 nonce cannot replay. The 49 fixtures include fake timeout/nonzero/banner/key/auth/UID cases, fixed safe alias, replayable positive route and SSH identity witnesses, strict host-key-pinned read-only id-u argv, private process cleanup, no HK01/graph/device/container/namespace/global proxy write. These code observations do not cure the two validator gaps.
minimal_new_generation_fix: Freeze a new runner that bounds child_rc to an explicit OS exit/signal range and byte counts to a documented maximum, rejects rc/category/stage contradictions, and enforces monotonic instance-stage implications (positive PROVEN requires local REJECT and post-SSH guards; no SSH outcome cannot claim SSH stages). Add the two exact negative inputs above and several neighboring contradictions to the no-credential fixtures, rerun them, then obtain a new independent review before any root one-shot release.
